contains
    integer function count_subarrays(nums, k) result(count)

        i = 1

def longest_common_subsequence(strings: List[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if not strings:
        return None

                dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1
            else:
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])

    # Reconstruct the longest common subsequence
    lcs = []
    i, j = len(strings), len(strings[0])
    while i > 0 and j > 0:
        if strings[i-1][j-1] == strings[i-2][j-2]:
            lcs.append(strings[i-2][j-2])
            i -= 1
            j -= 1
        elif dp[i-1][j] > dp[i][j-1]:
            i -= 1
        else:
            j -= 1

    lcs.reverse()
    return ''.join(lcs) if lcs else None
